note: 27 pages, 595.28x841.89. 28 measured regions on 19 pages: 16 raster exhibits (Figures 1-10 and 12-17) plus 12 identical full-page two-path boxes refused as page furniture. Text-layer captions cover every figure the paper prints except Figure 11, which is a raster on the zero-text p16 sheet together with Tables 1, 4 and 5 on p5/p15; those five sheets have no text and no measured region, so Figure 11 and the three tables are declared gaps. Tables 2 and 3 are text-layer grids with no measured region and are also declared gaps.
rules: Caption polarity is a class property and it is measured, not assumed: all 16 figure captions print BELOW their art and both table captions print ABOVE the first rule - each figure caption's bbox y was compared against its region bbox. [caption.position]
One numbering form for the whole run - 'Figure N:' and 'Table N:' - with no 'Fig.' abbreviation, no roman numeral and no caption that omits its number. [caption.numbering]

Not one exhibit is ever named a second time in the prose: the only occurrences of the words Figure and Table in the whole text layer are the caption lines themselves, so all 16 exhibits carry first_page null and count 0. [mention.first_page]

Pointing exists but is deictic and unnumbered - 'the results showed the following:' immediately over Figure 10 and 'as shown below:' immediately over Figure 16 - which is why the mention block stays empty while the art is still argued from. [mention.lead_pattern]

Captions are bare noun phrases: one sentence, three to twelve words, no variable symbol, no unit, no condition and no verb of conclusion, so the caption block is identical for all 16 figures. [caption.words]

Rasters are pasted screenshots carrying a translucent pink WeChat watermark (微信公众号：数学模型 微信号：MATHmodels) across the art; it is heaviest over Figures 12, 14, 16 and 17 but never covers a printed value. [geometry.family]

Datum labelling follows what the reader has to compare: the two exhibits whose marks are unreadable from the axis print every datum on the mark (Figure 7's ten bars, Figure 15's 100 cells), while the line, grouped-bar and scatter exhibits print ticks only. [geometry.data_labels]

Legend placement splits three ways and never stays inside its own plot for long: inside the frame in Figures 10 and 16, outside at the right in Figures 5 and 9, and absent from the other twelve. [geometry.legend]

Both colour keys are continuous ramps - 'Log(Number of Incidents)' 0-8 on the Figure 3 map and -0.75 to 1.00 on the Figure 15 matrix - so printed_numbers is true on both and no exhibit uses a stepped class swatch. [geometry.colorbar]
Nothing in the paper is 3-D; the only depth cue anywhere is the perspective monitor bezel that frames the Figure 2 workflow. [geometry.three_d]

Small multiples are built the opposite way from each other: Figure 14 is a 3x3 grid of nine scatter panels that each carry their own axes and their own 'Filtered: Total_Incidents vs <variable> (Spearman)' title, so shared_axes is false, while Figure 15's single matrix has shared row and column labels. [geometry.panel_layout]

Two exhibits abandon axes altogether - a five-lobe domain diagram (Figure 1) and a four-tab policy schematic (Figure 13) - and neither prints a number, an axis title or a scale. [geometry.printed_numbers]

A word cloud and a donut triptych fall outside the plot vocabulary and are recorded as family 'other' with the mark named in other_note, rather than being forced into bar or composite-panel. [geometry.family]

Figure 6 is a 13-row country table captioned as a Figure and its only rules are conditional cell fills, so it is recorded table-as-figure with every value printed rather than as a heatmap. [geometry.family]

Section placement had to be taken from the caption's own printed position: nine of the 16 regions are measured under a heading that opens AFTER them - Figure 1 filed under 1.2 although it ends 1.1, Figure 2 under section 2 although it ends 1.3, Figure 6 under 4.3.2 although it prints inside 4.3.3, Figure 10 under 5.2.3 although it verifies 5.2.2, Figure 12 under 5.3.2 although it closes 5.3.1, Figure 13 under 5.4 although it closes 5.3.2, Figure 15 under 6.2 although it closes 6.1, Figures 16 and 17 under 6.3 although they close 6.2. [place.section_path]

A heading the index never captured is kept as printed: Figure 12's true section 5.3.1 ('Analysis of GCI's Five Pillars') prints only inside the zero-text p16 raster, so its path is a single unnumbered label carrying the printed title. [place.section_numbered]

p10's top-level heading is hyphen-broken across the line end - '5 National Security Policies and Global Cybercrime Dis-' - and is recorded with the break, because that broken string is what the text layer holds and a repaired title would be a fabrication. [place.section_path]

The caption numbering runs 1..10 then 12..17 because Figure 11 ('The five pillars of GCI', a raster wheel on p16) sits on a sheet with a zero-byte text layer, alongside Table 1 on p5 and Tables 4-5 on p15; the printed sequence is continuous and the hole is the pipeline's, not the authors'. [caption.numbering]

Twelve of the 28 measured regions are the same two-path box at bbox 27.3,39.3,567.8,797.5 (area 0.818) on twelve different pages - page furniture measured as a region and refused, and the p1 raster shows no printed page border to explain it. [place.area_frac]

Caption and art disagree twice and both are left standing: the p17 caption prints 'Averages Scores by GCI Pillars' over a chart titled 'Average Scores by GCI Pillars', and Figure 9's title claims 2014-2024 over an x axis that stops at 2022. [caption.verbatim]

Doc order is the print order everywhere: Figure 5 sits one caption below Figure 4 on p7 and Figure 17 one caption below Figure 16 on p21, so the pair order is fixed by the measured bbox y of each art, not by the caption order alone. [place.doc_order]
